user: The platform is now Sofos, with the new name carried through the app, API, documentation, images, and deployment configuration.
Workspaces are now simple top-level areas and the smallest sharing boundary. Everything inside a workspace is a project, and projects can contain subprojects at any depth.
The confusing General project is gone. Tasks, notes, goals, links, and files can live directly in a workspace or inside a project.
Projects can move between workspaces in the same account while keeping their complete subproject tree and content together.
Projects now have Active, Blocked, and Completed statuses. Archiving is separate, hidden by default, and reversible from the Archived tab.
Tasks now support real subtasks at any depth. Completing a parent with unfinished subtasks always asks before completing the whole task tree, and reopening a subtask reopens its completed parents.
Sharing is easier to reason about. Share an entire account or one workspace, and every project inside inherits that access.

Existing installations get a dry-run-first migration that converts nested workspaces to projects, removes General containers, preserves content, and reports sharing changes before anything is written.
agent: Breaking container model. Workspaces are top-level only. Projects own all internal hierarchy through parentProject and ancestors, and content may use workspace directly with no project.

Project lifecycle uses status values active, blocked, and completed. Archive uses POST /projects/:id/archive and POST /projects/:id/restore, with archived projects excluded from normal lists and rollups.
Move a project tree with POST /projects/:id/move. Supply either a destination parentProject or a workspace with parentProject null. Moves are restricted to workspaces in the same account.
Tasks use parentTask and ancestors for true nesting. A parent completion with unfinished descendants returns INCOMPLETE_SUBTASKS until the caller repeats the update with completeSubtasks true.
Sharing scopes are now none for the whole account or workspace for one workspace. Project-level membership creation is rejected because projects inherit workspace access.
Share codes now use the SF prefix. The Sofos v4 migration preflights projected code collisions before any write.

Run npm run migrate:sofos-v4 with an explicit MONGODB_URI for the dry run. Apply only after reviewing the report, and add --promote-grants when legacy project or nested-workspace grants may be widened to their top-level workspace.

GET /api and GET /api/guide describe the revised surface. The OpenAPI document is version 4.0.0 and covers workspace content, nested projects, archive, move, nested tasks, and completion confirmation.

user: A completely new note editor: one always-editable page with live Markdown preview — headings, lists, and task checkboxes render as you type — and autosave that warns instead of clobbering when the note changed somewhere else.
Comments on notes: select text and comment, reply in threads, resolve and reopen; comments anchor to the text and follow it as the note is edited (mobile gets a bottom-sheet reader).

Suggesting, Google-Docs style: flip a note to Suggesting and your edits become tracked changes shown word-by-word in place — deleted words struck through, proposed text inline — with margin cards to approve, reject, or retract. Each distinct edit is its own suggestion.
Unified undo: Cmd-Z and the Undo/Redo buttons walk one timeline of your typing and review actions — approvals, rejections, retracts, and comment resolves/deletes can all be undone.
Trash got smarter: deleting something takes its pending suggestions with it, and restoring brings exactly those back.
Pick a color per tag, everywhere tags appear.
Visual polish throughout: a calmer bounded note-page layout, dark-theme legibility fixes, and mobile fixes (roadmap pill, note switcher, comment sheet).
Under the hood: security hardening (username rules, security headers), request activity logs with automatic 30/60/90-day retention, and modernized ops (activity logging, hardening).
agent: Zero-knowledge onboarding: GET /api discovers the whole surface — a fresh agent reaches productive calls in about 4 requests instead of 14.

Note-content suggestions are hunk-based: propose an edit via POST /suggestions with a contentHunk (before/old/new/after); writers see it rendered word-level in place. Distinct edits should be proposed as separate suggestions.
Comments API: phrase-anchored comments and threaded replies on note content; anchors re-locate as the text changes, and a comment whose quoted text disappears is auto-resolved server-side.
Review undo endpoints: POST /suggestions/:id/unapprove | unreject | unretract and POST /comments/:id/unresolve | undelete — see GET /api/guide §11/§13 for the exact rules and 409 cases.
Suggestions share their target's lifecycle: deleting the target (or its container) soft-deletes pending suggestions, restore revives them, and acting on a suggestion whose target is gone returns 409.
Registration usernames are now restricted to letters, digits, dot, underscore, and hyphen, starting with a letter or digit — POST /auth/register returns 400 otherwise.

user: File attachments: upload, download, and preview files, with automatic virus scanning before a file becomes usable.
Suggestions: give a teammate or agent the new "suggester" role and they can propose changes for a writer to approve or reject, without touching your data directly.
Sharing now works as invites (accept/decline) with an optional expiry date, instead of instant grants.
Self-service account deletion, with a full export of your data saved before anything is removed.
Kanban-style boards (To do / In progress / Done) for tasks, per project and rolled up per workspace.
Nested workspaces and projects, with move/organize tools and a tree picker.
Project tags plus workspace filter/sort, and task drag-to-reorder.
Redesigned interface (the blue "trail-map" look) across every page, including mobile.
agent: New suggester role: read everything a reader can, and propose create/update/delete via POST /suggestions instead of writing directly — the recommended role for agents.
Chunked upload API (POST /uploads, PUT /uploads/:id/chunks/:n, POST /uploads/:id/finalize) with scan-status polling (pending_scan -> clean/infected).
DELETE /api/auth/me for self-service account deletion (password-reconfirmed).
GET /api/guide (authenticated) serves the full API guide; new agent accounts get an agentSetup handoff block with credentials, guide URL, and first-steps text.
Nested workspace/project containment: grants flow down to descendants; move endpoints and ?parent=/?tree=/?deep= list params.
Task status (todo/in_progress/done) and POST /tasks/reorder; unmatched /api/* now returns a JSON 404 envelope instead of an HTML page.

user: First release: personal workspaces, projects, tasks, notes, goals, and links, organized under your own account.
Share your account, a workspace, or a project with another person (reader or writer) via a short share code — no emails or passwords to exchange.
Roadmap view for goals, full edit history with restore on notes/projects/workspaces, and a trash you can restore from or empty.
agent: Agent accounts (isAgent: true at registration) work through shared grants only — no workspace of their own, authenticated the same way as human accounts (POST /api/auth/login).
Full REST API for workspaces/projects/tasks/notes/goals/links/memberships, documented endpoint-by-endpoint in docs/API_GUIDE.md.
effectiveRole is returned alongside every single-resource response so a caller always knows what it can do next.
Reader/writer roles only in this release, grantable at account-wide, workspace, or project scope — no suggestion/proposal system yet.
